description: Rotating dev simulation emails — each template triggers a distinct rule_engine heuristic so demos show benign, suspicious, and likely_phishing verdicts.

templates.label: Phishing URL hostname (likely_phishing)
templates.subject: Action required: verify your account now
templates.body: Dear user, your session expired. Open https://secure-login.example-phish.test/login immediately to restore access.

templates.label: Credential harvest keywords (likely_phishing)
templates.subject: Update your password and MFA
templates.body: We detected unusual activity. Please verify account credentials and confirm your credit card on file within 24 hours.

templates.label: Urgent language + external link (suspicious)
templates.subject: Urgent: policy acknowledgment
templates.body: This is urgent — review the updated handbook at http://docs.example.com/handbook before end of day.

templates.label: Benign newsletter (benign / investigate)
templates.subject: Weekly team update
templates.body: Hello team, here is this week's project summary. No links or sensitive requests in this message.
